notes: At each internal-pulser period, run N2 alone, N1 alone, then both crates concurrently in separate processes. Enable the same seven FEB/channel identities outside the union of hot channels observed on either crate, matching the multiplicity of earlier studies. For operational analysis use the empirically validated rate conversion rate_hz = 2e6 / period_ticks. Period ticks must be even because odd values reproducibly produce zero pulses. Use synchronous AUTO pulser mode, 20 ns width, and 31 frames per block. Leave external-trigger records/event at its default because this is a self-trigger scan. Retry transport/setup failures and zero-hit captures.
